layer_3_action.subject: A pod of three Plesiosaurus dolichodeirus
features: Varying sizes to represent a family pod
Soft teal and cream color palette
layer_3_action.action: The lead Plesiosaur is banking toward the viewer, while the other two follow closely, their necks undulating as they approach a group of floating cephalopods.

companions.description: A cluster of five large, colorful coiled ammonites in the mid-ground, showing stylized tentacles and small 'clay' bubbles as they bob in the current.

text_overlay.style: Bright red, 3D extruded clay-style lettering, mixed case, playful sans-serif font.
text_overlay.placement: Bottom center, slightly arched to follow the curve of the lead Plesiosaur's tail.

visual_logic.water: Rich cobalt blue with distinct 'god-rays' creating high-contrast light and shadow on the clay bodies.
visual_logic.atmosphere: Subtle marine snow and small rising air bubbles to enhance the sense of movement and depth.
